summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(), gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: tests and mypy (per instructions); nothing committed. Open issue: Console.control() drops output on dumb terminals, so set_window_title returns True there without writing anything, as the spec's terminal-only gate implies.
